form.label: Case 7: Autonomous AI Agent (Zero-Shot Explorer)
form.description: The AI Agent will autonomously explore your Splunk environment, write its own SPL queries, analyze the results, and decide the next steps until it solves your problem.

input.label: Agent Task Prompt
input.default: Check if there are any firewall logs in our environment. If yes, find out which source IP has the most 'deny' actions today.

search.query: | aiagent prompt="$user_prompt$" | eval Time = strftime(_time, "%H:%M:%S") | table Time step type content | rename step as Step, type as "Agent Action", content as Details

format.colorPalette: {"🔄 Thinking...": "#475569", "🤔 Agent Reasoning": "#3b82f6", "⚙️ Executing Query": "#f59e0b", "👀 Observation": "#10b981", "✅ Final Report": "#8b5cf6", "⚠️ Forced Termination": "#ef4444", "❌ Parsing Failed": "#ef4444"}
